repository_summary: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Rust is a pure-Rust library for reading and writing Excel .xlsx workbooks, modeled after Aspose.Cells but with no proprietary runtime. It is early-stage, MIT-licensed, and maintained as a free open-source project with a path to commercial upgrade.

Maintainer-authored content is preserved by default; no verified conflicts or required changes.
